name: Habits
description: A small self-hosted habit tracker with streaks and statistics

paths.name: Pb_Data
paths.description: The PocketBase database with every account, habit and check-in, plus the dashboard's own backups. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Habits web app and PocketBase admin dashboard, published on host as 6171

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PB_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: Optional. The email for the PocketBase admin dashboard at /_/. Set it together with PB_ADMIN_PASSWORD to make (or reset) the admin account on start. You don't need it to track habits.

variables.name: PB_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional. The admin dashboard password, at least 8 characters. Only used when PB_ADMIN_EMAIL is set too.
